catalyst_rows.indication: anemia in dialysis-dependent CKD (VOCAL Phase 3b TIW dosing)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Akebia expects topline data from VOCAL, a Phase 3b trial evaluating three times weekly (TIW) dosing of Vafseo versus ESAs, in Q4 2026

catalyst_rows.indication: anemia in dialysis-dependent CKD (VOICE Phase IV)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: topline data from VOICE, a large Phase IV trial of over 2,100 patients evaluating Vafseo TIW against standard-of-care ESAs using a hierarchical composite endpoint of all-cause mortality and all-cause hospitalization, in early 2027.

catalyst_rows.indication: IgA nephropathy, lupus nephritis, C3 glomerulopathy (basket)
catalyst_rows.raw_text: Akebia confirmed plans to initiate a Phase 2 open-label basket study to evaluate AKB-097 in IgA nephropathy, lupus nephritis and C3 glomerulopathy. Akebia expects to initiate the study in the second half of 2026 with initial data expected in 2027.
In April 2026, Akebia initiated a Phase 1 study of AKB-9090 in up to 70 healthy volunteers with topline data expected in early 2027.

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Multiple value drivers: VOCAL Phase 3b topline Q4 2026, VOICE Phase IV topline early 2027, AKB-097 Phase 2 basket initiation 2H 2026, AKB-9090 Phase 1 topline early 2027. Praliciguat Phase 2 FSGS dosing already started Jan 2026.
